_meta.source: research/R6_processing_taxonomy.md §3, cross-checked with routescoffee.co.uk, 1zpresso.coffee and font-mag.com guides (2026-10-02)
_meta.principle: A processing protocol is an ORDERED SEQUENCE OF STEPS. Each step carries its own axis vector. Named methods are labels over vectors; the vector is the truth. 'Lactic', 'acetic', 'malic', 'winey' are TARGET OUTCOMES (descriptor K), not axes.
_meta.orthogonality: Any value on one axis can combine with any value on another (some combinations are rare). Fruit state (A) and oxygen (B) usually change between steps, so they are stored per step.

A_fruit_state.question: How much fruit is on the seed during this step?

values.depulped_mucilage_full: skin off, all mucilage on (pulped natural, black honey)
values.depulped_mucilage_partial: skin off, part of mucilage on — requires mucilage_retained_pct
values.depulped_mucilage_removed_fermentation: mucilage degraded by fermentation then washed

values.sealed_self_induced: closed vessel, microbial CO2 displaces O2 (SIAF)
values.co2_flushed: headspace purged with CO2 (carbonic maceration when whole cherry)

values.cold_hold_prefermentation: pre-fermentative cold hold of intact cherry (CryoBloom, cold soak analogue)

values.backslopped: own must/mosto/lixiviado from a previous batch
values.inoculated_yeast_non_sacch: Torulaspora, Pichia, Hanseniaspora, Meyerozyma, Candida, Yarrowia…
values.bioprotection: Metschnikowia pulcherrima (MP-72) applied to intact cherry

extra_fields: inocula[] {organism, strain, product, supplier, dose, unit, rehydration, lot, regulatory_note}

values.own_coffee_derivative: must, cascara, pulp, mucilage, leachate from the same coffee
values.processing_aid: enzymes, salt brine, acids (tartaric), sugar as nutrient
values.exogenous_natural: fruit, cacao pulp, spices, hops, wine must, panela
values.exogenous_flavouring: extracts, essential oils, powders, synthetic flavourings

extra_fields: additions[] {substance, category, form, amount, unit, timing: pre_green|post_green, step_seq}
E_substrate_additions.regulatory_note: This is the axis competitions regulate. BoP 2024 excluded 'foreign additives'; WCC 2024 bans additions after the green stage. Inoculated yeast status at BoP/CoE 2026 NOT retrieved — confirm with SCAP in writing.

values.greenhouse_solar: parabolic, marquesina, tunnel, modular PC dryer

J_duration_derived.note: total and per-step hours — derived, not an axis

K_target_outcome_descriptor.note: NOT an axis. A 'lactic' or 'malic' label requires measured acid data or must be published as 'target profile'.

families.W: Washed (mucilage removed before drying) — fruit-state family
families.N: Natural / dry (whole cherry dried) — fruit-state family
families.H: Honey / pulped natural (skin off, mucilage dried on) — fruit-state family
families.AN: Anaerobic / sealed — oxygen-regime MODIFIER of W/N/H
families.CM: Carbonic maceration — oxygen-regime modifier (whole cherry + CO2)

genuinely_distinct_mechanisms: mucilage removal by fermentation vs mechanics vs enzymes
